Name: Better Journal
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43805]Continued[/url], Better Journal expands on the quest journal in vanilla Stardew Valley with a tab for your own custom tasks, and optionally a tab for tracking monster slaying goals without needing to visit the adventurers guild. 

Unlike Deluxe Journal this mod is focussed on a simple, vanilla-feeling extension of the existing journal. It does not have complex features like automatic task completion, repeating tasks, natural language parsing, persistent overlays, etc. If you want advanced functionality like this then I highly recommend Deluxe Journal.

Monster goals tracking can be configured on or off, and doesn't unlock until you enter the adventurers guild.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43805][/url]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with mods that add custom quests, just extends the vanilla quest log with new tabs[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with all UI recolours, uses vanilla UI assets[/*]
[*]Fully compatible with controllers/gamepads[/*]
[*]Fully compatible with multi-player[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to MolsonCAD for Deluxe Journal and kauf0 for the continued version, both of which inspired this mod.
